SELECT sc.id, sc.course_id, sc.exam_type, sc.score, sc.exam_date, c.course_name FROM score sc LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sc.exam_date DESC
